SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-05: FHIRPath — §5.3 Subsetting, §5.4 Combining. Test these items: [index] indexer, single(), first(), last(), tail(), skip(num), take(num), intersect(other), exclude(other), union(other), combine(other). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.evidence: Spec signatures require [index: Integer], zero-arg single()/first()/last()/tail(), one-arg skip(num)/take(num)/intersect(other)/exclude(other)/union(other)/combine(other). Native C++ accepts malformed calls that forced fallback rejects. Reproducer: .temp/qa/fp05_skeptic_probe.py. Native outputs include a.first(0) -> ['zero'] with fhirpath_is_valid=true, a.tail(0) -> ['one','two'] with is_valid=true, a.skip(1, 2) -> ['one','two'] with is_valid=true, a.union(b, ints) -> ['zero','one','two','three'] with is_valid=true, and a.skip(1.0) has is_valid=true on sparse validation input. Forced Python fallback returns empty/NULL and fhirpath_is_valid=false for these malformed calls.
issues.root_cause: Native Evaluator::evalFunction dispatched FP-05 functions without exact child-count validation, so zero-argument functions ignored unexpected arguments and one-argument collection functions ignored extra arguments. fn_skip/fn_take also returned early for empty input before validating the num argument, letting fhirpath_is_valid() accept invalid count expressions on its sparse Patient validation resource.
issues.resolution: Added exact arity guards for single/first/last/tail, skip/take, and combine/intersect/exclude/union in the native evaluator. Reordered skip/take count validation before empty-input short-circuiting. Added native sqllogictest and Python native-vs-forced-fallback parity coverage, rebuilt and copied bundled fhirpath.duckdb_extension.
